history.title: Our History
history.text: Greenprod Sustainable was born with the conviction that productivity and caring for the environment can go hand in hand. We are a company focused on driving agricultural and marine productivity through innovative practices, producing organic fertilizers and generating value in seafood products to improve the quality of life of local communities.

missionVision.title: Mission and Vision
missionVision.missionText: To drive agricultural and marine productivity through innovative and environmentally friendly practices, producing organic fertilizers and seafood products that improve the quality of life of local communities.
missionVision.visionText: To be a leading company in the production of agricultural bio-inputs and sustainable seafood products, recognized for our innovation, environmental commitment, and contribution to responsible agriculture and fishing that promote healthy ecosystems.

Cookies.title: This site uses cookies
Cookies.body: We use cookies that are necessary for the site to work and, if you accept, measurement cookies to understand which sections get visited most. They are not shared with third parties for advertising.
Cookies.essentialDesc: They keep your cart and language. They cannot be turned off because the site does not work without them.
Cookies.analyticsDesc: They tell us how many people visit and which pages they see, aggregated and anonymous.
Cookies.note: Cookies do not give access to your email or your social accounts. If you want news by email, subscribe below: that is separate and it is your choice.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Green Prod & Sustainable S.A.C., located at Av. Uno Mz. 1 Lote 1, Bloque "E", AA.HH. Tres Estrellas, Nuevo Chimbote, Áncash, is responsible for the personal data collected on this site. This policy explains what data we ask for, what we use it for and how you can control it, under Peru's Personal Data Protection Law 29733 and its regulations.
Privacy.reviewNotice: Document pending legal review. The company tax ID (RUC) and the personal data bank registration number with the National Authority for Personal Data Protection still need to be filled in.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Only what you give us in a form: to place an order we ask for your name or company name, DNI or RUC, email, phone and delivery address; through the contact form, your name, company, email and message; to subscribe to news, only your email. We do not collect sensitive data and we do not buy third-party lists.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: Order details are used to fulfil the order, arrange payment and delivery and issue the receipt. Contact form details are used to reply to you. The subscription email is used only to send you news, launches and promotions, and nothing else.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use necessary cookies, which keep your cart and language and without which the site does not work, and measurement cookies, which are only enabled if you accept them and tell us in aggregate, anonymous form how many people visit and which pages they see. You can refuse the measurement ones without losing any feature. Cookies only reach this site: they give no access to your email, your social accounts or your activity on other pages.

sections.heading: Marketing emails
sections.body: Accepting cookies does not subscribe you to anything. You will only receive emails if you enter your address in the subscription form and tick the consent box. Every email carries an unsubscribe link, and you can also ask to be removed by writing to us.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: We do not sell or transfer personal data. We share it only with those needed to fulfil your order: the carrier that delivers the product and, once online payment is enabled, the gateway that processes the charge. Your card details never pass through this site: they are entered directly in the gateway form.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Order data is kept for as long as the commercial relationship lasts and for the period required by tax regulations. The subscription email is kept until you ask to be removed.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to your data, its correction, its deletion, or object to our use of it, by writing to contacto@greenprod.pe. We reply within the deadlines set by law. If you believe your request was not handled, you may complain to the National Authority for Personal Data Protection of the Ministry of Justice.

Privacy.contactBody: For any question about this policy or your data: contacto@greenprod.pe · +51 919 514 085
